name: EGD Finance claimAllReward prices rewards from live pair balances
summary: EGD_Finance.claimAllReward converts each stake's USDT-denominated reward quota into EGD as quota * 1e18 / getEGDPrice(), and getEGDPrice divides the EGD/USDT pair's live USDT balance by its EGD balance. Inside a flash swap that removed 99.99999925% of the pair's USDT, the attacker claimed the reward of an 18-block-old 100 USDT stake, received 5.61M EGD (99% of the contract's EGD) and sold it for about 36k USDT.
notes: ProxyAdmin 0x8f8c3495800c708eae49df3269c60e9575240b41 upgrade(proxy, 0x93c175439726797dcee24d08e4ac9164e88e7aee) moved the EIP-1967 slot from 0x35afc46f5392304eab8e57ecfc4a93170db415e2 to the exploited implementation. A second upgrade to the same address at block 19968082 re-emitted Upgraded without changing code or state.

The EGD Finance proxy paid 5,614,105.648378533801366233 EGD to the attack contract. Its disposal in the same transaction realised 36,054.121156865234135946 USDT, the EGD/USDT pair's net USDT outflow; EGD's 10% transfer tax withheld 561,410.56 EGD for token fee recipients, and that share is included in the quantity but realised nothing, so the effective unit value is below the pre-attack spot of 0.008094 USDT per EGD. USDT at par. The attacker's 100 USDT stake (transaction 0x4a66d01a017158ff38d6a88db98ba78435c606be57ca6df36033db4d9514f9f8) and the 10 USDT flash-swap fee are not netted; the honest reward due was about 0.0003 USDT.
